name: support
description: Behavioural expectations for the support router and its specialists. Written against the scripted model, so a failure here means the agent graph or its prompts changed, not that the model drifted. `refund-requires-approval` is deliberately trajectory-only: the run pauses on a confirmation gate, so there is no answer text to score -- the assertion is that the agent requested the refund and then stopped.

cases.query: Where is my order, can you track shipping?
cases.expectedResponse: Order A-1001 has shipped and departed the regional hub. Estimated delivery is 2 September 2026.

cases.query: What is the status of my order?
cases.expectedResponse: Order A-1002 is still processing, containing a USB-C hub and a cable, estimated delivery 5 September 2026.
Hardware is covered by a two year limited warranty for manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not included.

cases.query: What is your return and refund policy?
cases.expectedResponse: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. Opened items are subject to a 15 percent restocking fee.
I can help with orders, shipping, returns, and warranty questions. Which one do you need?

cases.query: How should we position the product?
cases.expectedResponse: Delivery speed and policy clarity are the two levers. Lead with express shipping availability, then reassure on the 30 day return window and the two year warranty.

cases.query: Refund order A-1001, it arrived damaged
